methodology: Chromium at 1280x800 against local next start builds backed by a local KV fixture on the same machine. Click latency is the time from a button click to the pair headline text changing, measured with MutationObserver, 10 alternating left/right clicks per variant, 300 ms apart. DOM sizes are a single page load per build. Not production measurements.

baseline.label: c3d4d82 baseline: server action awaited, cookie refresh before UI advances

optimistic.label: integrated: client queue advances immediately, server action runs in the background

optimistic.note: after() once the response is sent

rapidBurst.note: 12 synchronous clicks first exposed an index-batching bug that advanced past the queue and unmounted the arena. After tracking the index in a ref, 8 clicks 40 ms apart yielded 9 unique pairs, and a follow-up synchronous burst of 12 clicks left a rendered pair and a working button.
